definitions.explanation: Used to describe things that form a contrast or are being compared with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対比的|たいひてき}だ。
{対比的|たいひてき}な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対比的|たいひてき}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: His opinion stands in contrast to mine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{対比的|たいひてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a novel that depicts urban and rural life in contrast.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧ (contrast/comparison) with the ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ suffix. Used in academic, artistic, and formal discussion to describe things placed in contrast or juxtaposition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対比的|たいひてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to depict in contrast
- {対比的|たいひてき}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: contrasting expression
- {対比的|たいひてき}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: contrastive relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対照的|たいしょうてき}→対照的：12369_taishouteki⟧: contrastive — very close synonym, more commonly used in everyday language
- ⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧: comparatively/relatively — used as an adverb meaning "relatively"
- ⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧: contrast/comparison — the base noun
